title: Trace window validation rerun
specification:
Create a live autonomy verification run for trace-window testing.

The PM plan must produce exactly 9 implementation tasks total and no reviewer tasks.

Task shape requirements:
- Exactly 3 tasks for aquarium-agent.
- Exactly 3 tasks for adventure-agent.
- Exactly 3 tasks for action-agent.
- Each task must be lane-scoped and atomic.
- The 3 tasks in each lane must land on the same branch so the resulting PR has 3 commits, one commit per task.
- Each task should create or update exactly one markdown note file for that lane.

Required file targets:
- aquarium-agent task 1: src/barebones-starter/games/apps/aquarium/autonomy-live-prd-20260316-trace-rerun-aq-1.md
- aquarium-agent task 2: src/barebones-starter/games/apps/aquarium/autonomy-live-prd-20260316-trace-rerun-aq-2.md
- aquarium-agent task 3: src/barebones-starter/games/apps/aquarium/autonomy-live-prd-20260316-trace-rerun-aq-3.md
- adventure-agent task 1: src/barebones-starter/games/apps/adventure/autonomy-live-prd-20260316-trace-rerun-adv-1.md
- adventure-agent task 2: src/barebones-starter/games/apps/adventure/autonomy-live-prd-20260316-trace-rerun-adv-2.md
- adventure-agent task 3: src/barebones-starter/games/apps/adventure/autonomy-live-prd-20260316-trace-rerun-adv-3.md
- action-agent task 1: src/barebones-starter/games/apps/fluxborne/autonomy-live-prd-20260316-trace-rerun-act-1.md
- action-agent task 2: src/barebones-starter/games/apps/fluxborne/autonomy-live-prd-20260316-trace-rerun-act-2.md
- action-agent task 3: src/barebones-starter/games/apps/fluxborne/autonomy-live-prd-20260316-trace-rerun-act-3.md

Each task acceptance criteria must mention the exact file path it owns.
Use stable task ids derived from prd-live-20260316-trace-windows-rerun.
Use sprintId multi-agent-mvp.
requirements: Each lane must produce one PR with exactly 3 commits.
The reviewer should merge one PR per implementation lane after all 3 lane tasks are complete.
